rules.title: Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) Annual Allowable Rent Increase
rules.requirement: Landlords of rent-stabilized units in Los Angeles may only raise rent each year by a capped percentage set annually by the city, and can no longer add a separate utility surcharge percentage starting February 2026.
rules.coverage_conditions: Applies to rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance, generally properties first built on or before October 1, 1978 (plus certain replacement units, condos/townhomes with pre-1996 tenancies, duplexes, multiple single-family units on one parcel, long-term hotel/rooming house rooms, ADUs/JADUs, and mobile homes).
rules.exemptions: Condominiums and townhomes are not rent-regulated for tenancies commencing after December 31, 1995.
rules.quoted_span:
Annual rent increases for rental units subject to the City of Los Angeles Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO), effective
July 1, 2025, through June 30, 2026
is
